summary: Milestone 2026.05.131 operational retrospective complete. Analyzed 1267 min wall time / 231 experiments (avg 5 min). Slowest paths included Exp 1603 (88 min) and Exp 1663 doomed-rerun block (82 min). GPUs were completely idle at 0% utilization, indicating a missed opportunity for parallelization. No zombie processes detected.
slowest_experiments: Exp 1603: Energy-Based Constraint Network (EBCN) coherence sco (88 min)
Exp 1663: Doomed-rerun block: gated on Exp 1662 (82 min)
Exp 1657: KV260 EBRM Hardware Offload (57 min)
Exp 1642: llguidance adapter for reusable external structured- (54 min)
Exp 1653: NSVIF DSL SOTA GGUF Integration (53 min)
bottlenecks_identified: Doomed-rerun block: Exp 1663 wasted 82 min waiting on a failing/gated upstream experiment instead of failing fast.
Sequential execution: Independent tasks like Exp 1603, 1657, 1642 ran sequentially instead of parallelizing.
DualGPU IDLE: Both RTX 3090s sat at 0% utilization (5MB/4MB allocated), meaning DualGPURunner was unused and potential throughput was halved.
improvements_suggested: Fix doomed-rerun preflight to emit terminal blocked artifacts in <1s instead of rediscovering blocked states.
Enforce DualGPURunner by default for GPU-eligible experiments to utilize both RTX 3090s.
Parallelize independent CPU and GPU execution lanes.
meta_reflection: Execution efficiency remains bottlenecked by the same patterns (idle GPUs, sequential execution, doomed-rerun waits) highlighted in previous retros. Mechanical conductor-level enforcement is necessary to realize the 40% estimated savings.
